entries.query_str: virginia tech parking citation appeal how many days do i have
entries.answer: Virginia Tech Parking Services generally requires citation appeals to be submitted **online within 10 business days** of the citation date through the parking portal; after that the citation stands and must be paid [1][2]. Include photos and your permit number if you're appealing on signage or a valid-permit basis. Check the date printed on your citation and the current policy page, since deadlines can change by academic year [1].
